name: Anjou Rui
source:
3rd year student.
Star Sign: Leo
Likes: Italian Food
Dislikes: Junk Food

Friendly without prejudice to anyone, everyone's mood maker.
He talks frivolously but can sometimes show a sad face.
He's rarely seen acting serious.
He has a special talent to make anybody who sees him dance become entranced.
